recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-24677; FHIR-22484 can be separately audited only if a future run requires a dedicated commit for that older same-change-family issue.
issue_request: FHIR-24677 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core correction, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, reporting that the contactable participant pattern had an Address-typed element named ParticipationContactable.active/ParticipantContactable.active. Its resolution says the element should be ParticipationContactable.address.
initial_application: The Jira comment records "lloyd-changes 5a23b840ab". Commit 5a23b840ab2e1b5291e37c1252a603664ac7b441 is titled "FHIR-24677 - Changed 'active' to 'address' in ParticipationContactable pattern" and changes source/participantcontactable/participantcontactable-spreadsheet.xml from ParticipantContactable.active to ParticipantContactable.address.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists participantcontactable in the active [logical] section, so the spreadsheet is current build-scope source. Current source also has the ParticipantContactable.address search parameter path, mapping exceptions refer to ParticipantContactable.address where relevant, and exact source searches found no stale ParticipantContactable.active, ParticipationContactable.active, or ParticipantContractable.active occurrences. FHIR-22484 requested the same rename before FHIR-24677 and cites the same applying commit; FHIR-37872 raised the same problem later and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source already reflects the Jira resolution and no source change is needed.
